name: Challenge Modes
description: Hardcore, Iron Man and other self-imposed challenge modes via a Shrine of Challenge NPC.

keys.label: Enable challenge modes
keys.explain: Enable challenge modes. If set to 0, all challenges will be disabled, and the challenge mode selection object will not be present in starting areas.

keys.label: Offer the Hardcore challenge
keys.explain: If set to 0, this challenge option will not be selectable at the challenge modes object.

keys.label: Hardcore XP multiplier
keys.explain: Multiplies XP the player gains if this challege is enabled. This is a multiplier values, so bonus are applied multiplicatively.

keys.label: Hardcore talent rewards
keys.explain: Rewards talent points for players when reaching the given levels with the challenge enabled. The format is the level followed by the number of talent points given at that level, separated by commas.

keys.label: Hardcore item rewards
keys.explain: Rewards items for players when reaching the given levels with the challenge enabled. The IDs used are item entry IDs. The format is the level followed by the item ID, separated by commas. Example: Hardcore.ItemRewards = "80 54811".

keys.note: MUST be 1 or the module does nothing
keys.label: Character-specific settings
keys.explain: Enables the usage of character specific settings.

patches.note: nl-saw fork has the old OnPlayerResurrect signature (bool vs bool&); patched so it compiles against current AzerothCore. wow-manage.sh 5715-5739

notes: Shrine of Challenge NPC appears near starting zones.
